## Astraeus 2.6.5

### New
- **Chrome.** A new look in Settings → Material: liquid chrome. The panel is polished metal whose bright and dark bands bend and flow while it's open, with a ring of brighter chrome around its edge and cards of smoked glass so everything stays easy to read. The pill, the board and the swatch wear the same metal, held still.
  - It only moves while the panel is open, and stops entirely with Reduce motion.

### Fixed
- **The pill over your apps** keeps its right widget against the edge, the same as the left one, instead of leaving a gap after short values like `4%`. Thanks to @jorjanion (#8).

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
